facts.text: Under Bethel's Career Choice Commitment, the college helps repay student loans if a graduate's earnings fall below the program's qualifying income threshold.

sources.title: Career Choice Commitment - Bethel College
sources.quote: If offered, the Career Choice Commitment serves as a loan repayment safety net provided through Bethel at no cost to you or your family. After graduating and becoming employed, if your earnings fall below the program's qualifying income threshold, we will help repay your loans
